She flew into the alien mothership to bring her father home. Inside, she found the one person she had stopped waiting for.
THE WOLF FATHER 4 (2026) | Sci-Fi Movie in 4K — Part 4 · 

▶ Part 1: https://youtu.be/KFds9-Rmey4 ·
▶ Part 2: https://youtu.be/bUfsuiuV2D0
▶ Part 3: https://youtu.be/IzQXfmv-wwU


In THE WOLF FATHER 4, the alien mothership has taken Lena's father — the pilot who became a wolf — and the Weavers are rewriting him into one of their own. At sunset the ship leaves our sky.

Lena goes up after him. With her: a squad of soldiers, Grom the giant polar bear, and Spark, the tiny creature made of light.

Inside the mothership: a farm of countless human cocoons, eyeless glass hounds, a towering Colossus, and the Watcher, who decides who gets rewritten. And on a bridge of glass, a silver she-wolf in ice armour who says she has no daughter.

Lena's mother has been gone for twenty years. The aliens changed her first.

This full sci-fi action movie combines an alien invasion, werewolves, a giant polar bear, an epic battle inside an alien mothership, and a family torn apart three times — that has one last chance to come back together in the sky.

Watch to the very end. This was only one farm.

Would you have gone up after him? Leave a comment and subscribe for more original AI sci-fi movies and THE WOLF FATHER saga.
